purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA JMA standard medical receipt (claim) software system. It processes and aggregates insurance claim data (診療報酬請求書 - medical fee claim forms) for combination/grouped insurers, reading temporary claim files and producing updated claim DB records and error files. It handles various public expense (公費) insurance categories and prints claim summary forms.
purpose.domain: healthcare/medical billing (Japanese national health insurance claims processing)

verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but comments are actually Japanese EUC-JP encoding, causing garbled display. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) medical billing system used in Japanese clinics. The COPY includes reference .INC files typical of the ORCA codebase. Revision history spans 2005-2013 with named developers, confirming production-grade software.
